summary: Adds read-only portal dashboards for places, weekly rhythm, and route corridors, plus a per-person profile drawer.
details: The existing map route now includes authenticated place graphs, hour-of-week dwell heatmaps, and Leaflet trip paths backed by presence analytics.

A slide-over profile drawer (from a sidebar row's chevron or a map marker's popup) digests one member's top places by dwell, weekday rhythm, and signature corridors named from their address-sequence ends.
limitations: Route paths use the existing bounded presence history window for each selected trip.
Corridor names are the raw address-sequence endpoints, not derived-place names (Home/Work) yet.
